records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, total operating revenue increased $260 million or 9%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, Passenger revenue increased $223 million, or 9%, as traffic increased by 4% and yield grew by 5%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Hawaiian passenger revenue has improved meaningfully compared to 2024, driven by the integration of its operations into Air Group's combined network and increased asset utilization.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a pro forma basis, total operating expenses increased $132 million, or 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $459 million during the first three months of 2025.
